scope: Frozen option opportunities with exact path hashes, contracts, times, quantities and premium caps. Baseline reproduces legacy SL fill replacement. Intermediate preserves verified close-only fills. Final also observes minute highs for UTS premium locks. No new opportunities are generated.
final_pnl_precision: Final modeled costs use unrounded helper fills and round only net P&L. Earlier flat-cost stages round fills to reproduce frozen display arithmetic.

cost_model_verification.reason: Freeze the cost fraction that exactly reproduces recorded charges.

limitations: Minute OHLC lacks tick order. Existing stops are checked first. New locks cross at observed close or apply in the next minute.
A frozen opportunity cohort does not simulate changed portfolio overlap, capital constraints, later admissions or retry opportunities.
Twenty-second buffering and ten-second repaint checks require finer data.
Results do not guarantee profit or executable broker fills.
